messages:
alex: Morning — I'm Alex, starting on Data Infra today. I haven't received an Okta activation email, Google Workspace says 'user not provisioned', and the 1Password team link from the onboarding doc gives a 403. Also need SSH access to repos. Who's the right contact?

it-ops-bot: Automation: No Okta activation found for alex@redwood.dev. Please confirm company email and region. If correct, open a ticket in #it-ops or DM @rachel.

rachel: Welcome @alex! Confirming: alex@redwood.dev and which OS are you on? We'll resend the Okta link and kick the Google sync.

alex: Confirmed alex@redwood.dev. Running Ubuntu 22.04 on a ThinkPad. No invite in spam/promotions.

rachel: Okta activation resent and Google provisioning job queued. Should be a few minutes.

it-ops-bot: System: Okta activation resent to alex@redwood.dev (job 110022). Google Workspace provisioning queued.

alex: I got the Okta email and completed the activation, but when I click our SSO app in Brave it keeps bouncing back to the sign-in page (infinite redirect). Firefox works. Also Okta is asking for SMS but our policy uses TOTP — how do I switch?

marco: Hi @alex — for Brave/Chromium-based browsers try brave://settings/shields and disable cross-site protections for redwood.okta.com or clear site data for that origin. Incognito or a clean profile is a quick workaround.

marco: For MFA: go to Security -> Set up authenticator app in Okta after sign-in. You can add Google Authenticator/Authenticator app and scan the QR. SMS is a fallback only. If Okta forces SMS, ping @security.

alex: Cleared site data, that fixed the redirect! I was able to add an authenticator app and switch to TOTP. 1Password link still shows 403 in browser though.

rachel: I just added you to the company 1Password account and the data-infra vault. If the browser link still 403s, try the CLI:

```bash
# sign in to 1Password CLI for redwood
eval "$(op signin redwood)"
op account get --account redwood
```

If you hit errors please paste the sanitized output.

alex: Tried CLI and got a 401 with message 'you are not a member of this account' (sanitized).

rachel: Sorry, missed that step when provisioning. Fixed the invite and re-linked your account. Try the CLI again.

alex: CLI signin succeeded, I can see 'data-infra' vault now. Browser still 403 but CLI is good enough for me. Quick question on SSH: should I add my public key to GitHub Enterprise myself or request platform to add it to internal deploy manager?

devex: For developer access, add your SSH public key to your GitHub Enterprise profile and then request org/repo access in #eng-setup. For deploy keys or service access, open a ticket with eng-platform and include the public key.

alex: Added the key to GitHub and requested org access in #eng-setup. Happy to be onboarded — thanks for the quick help everyone! :tada:

rachel: Welcome to Data Infra @alex — DM me if anything else blocks you.
